title: Release plan
description:
Thanks for developing this super useful package. It has saved me a bunch of time. I use it to add workflowr projects to [workflowr.io](https://workflowr.io/).

I see that you use the package to support your awesome R-universe project. Do you have plans to release it more widely? At minimum, would you be able to create a tag/release on GitHub?

By the way, please let me know if there is any way I can help you out with package maintenance.
